name: Volrath's Garden
description: The garden on Rath into which Mirri and Crovax tumbled.

timeline.summary: Mirri sees Crovax sabotaging the Weatherlight's sails, attacks him, and both tumble overboard into Volrath's Garden.
timeline.quote: She attacked Crovax, causing both of them to tumble overboard into Volrath's Garden .

timeline.summary: Mirri lets Crovax kill her so that Gerrard will save himself, fulfilling the spirit beast's prophecy.
